description: The pie chart represents the distribution of reference answers and test cases, comparing three categories. The chart is divided into three slices. The largest slice, colored red, is labeled "Null" and accounts for approximately 39.1% of the total. The second-largest slice, colored blue, is labeled "Have reference answer" and represents about 38.9%. The smallest slice, colored green, is labeled "Have test case" and makes up around 21.9%. The chart includes a legend that corresponds to the colors used for each category, and percentage labels are displayed outside the chart next to their respective slices. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order, starting with "Null" at the top left, followed by "Have reference answer", and then "Have test case".
